title: 复用降低建立成本，也有池风险
premise: MTU试验需审批且原因未定，讨论冷连接建立开销的独立优化方案。
listeningTask: 听清复用的收益、空闲连接风险和并发限制。

lines.en: Okay, connection reuse could avoid repeated handshakes. Our client currently opens many short connections.
lines.zh: 好，连接复用可以避免重复握手。目前客户端建立很多短连接。

lines.en: What closes them, client policy or server? Reuse won't help if the server closes first.
lines.zh: 是什么关闭连接，客户端策略还是服务端？服务端先关闭的话复用没用。

lines.en: Client pooling is disabled for this integration. The server supports bounded persistent connections.
lines.zh: 这个集成关闭了客户端连接池，服务端支持有限度的持久连接。

lines.en: So round-trip time remains, but setup shrinks. That isn't a shorter network route.
lines.zh: 所以往返时间还在，但建立开销减少了，不代表网络路径变短。

lines.en: Just to confirm, test stale connections too, right? Idle timeouts could change the outcome.
lines.zh: 我确认一下，也测试失效旧连接，对吧？空闲超时可能影响结果。

lines.en: Yes, align pool expiry below server timeout. Add jitter to avoid synchronized reconnect bursts.
lines.zh: 是，把池过期时间设得低于服务端超时，加抖动避免同时重连。

lines.en: And cap concurrency rather than growing indefinitely. Queue delay belongs in the measurements too.
lines.zh: 还要限制并发，不能无限增长。排队延迟也要计入测量。

lines.en: I'm on it for those client limits. We'll keep an eye on pool waits.
lines.zh: 这些客户端限制我来做，也会留意连接池等待。

lines.en: If we're seeing connection resets during tests, compare idle age. Avoid blind payment retries.
lines.zh: 如果测试发现连接重置，就比较空闲时长。不要盲目重试支付。

lines.en: So, sandbox calls first, roughly current concurrency. Production adoption still needs a separate review.
lines.zh: 所以先用沙箱调用，并发接近当前水平。生产采用仍需单独评审。
